speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia secondary to recent myocardial infarction.

The sudden onset of abdominal pain out of proportion to exam, combined with bloody stools and your recent heart attack, suggests your mesenteric arteries may be blocked. I need to confirm this immediately. REQUEST TEST: CT Angiography of the Abdomen and Pelvis. REQUEST IMAGES: CT Abdomen_Pelvis.
